name: Kumotta Hitomi ni Koishiteru
source:
It's weirdly loud in the classroom today...
Huh? A girl from another class slit her wrist?
That's awful...

Which reminds me, I cut myself really bad with a chisel back in grade school!
That hurt so much the color drained from my face.
At some point, I saw her... Sanshiki Sumire, that is. I'm glad her wound doesn't seem all that serious♪

I feel like I've been seeing her more often recently...
Before I realize, I can see her from the corner of my eye.

Huh?! Is she stalking me?
Nah, that can't be it.
There's just no way... yup, no way!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ249792.html]DLsite[/url]]
